basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to owner occupy a gorgeous top floor residence with great rental income from the unit below! Located in sunny Potrero Hill, this duplex is the one! The top floor view home is a 3 bedroom, one bath, full-floor residence with views from Bernal Hill to Twin Peaks. It boasts amazing indoor/outdoor living as the kitchen overlooks and is just steps from the massive terraced sunny garden that is awaiting your green thumb and creative ideas! The lower unit is a two bedroom tenant occupied home and is a great source of income. The garage has a ton of storage and fits 2 cars tandem and is currently rented month to month. These residences are perfectly located near all that Potrero and Mission 18th and 24th Street corridors have to offer - craft cocktail bars, artisanal coffee, shopping, parks and amazing restaurants. Great transit, easy freeway access, just a few blocks to SF General, easy stroll to Caltrain, the Dogpatch and so much more. Don't miss this fabulous opportunity!
